question: Which Spanish football team play their home games at the Bernabeu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Real Madrid.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Real Madrid** is one of the most successful football clubs in the world, with a record **13 European Cup/UEFA Champions** League titles.
 
• The **Bernabeu stadium** is the home ground of Real Madrid.
 
• It has a capacity of **over 81,000 spectators **and is located in the city center of Madrid.
 
• The stadium has been the venue for several high-profile football matches, including the finals of the** European Cup/UEFA Champions League and the World Cup.**
 
• Real Madrid has a fierce rivalry with** Barcelona,** who play their home games at the **Camp Nou stadium.**
 
• The two teams compete in the **El Clasico derby**, which is one of the most watched football matches in the world

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Elche** is a **Spanish football club** that currently plays in the second division of the Spanish league system.

 
 
• Their home ground is the **Estadio Manuel Martinez Valero,** which is located in the city of Elche.
 
 
 
• **Barcelona** is another top **Spanish football club**, with a record **5 European Cup/UEFA Champions** League titles.
 
 
• They play their home games at the** Camp Nou stadium,** which has a capacity of over **99,000 spectators.**
 
 
 
• **Athletic Madrid** (also known as Atletico Madrid) is a Spanish football club that has won the **Spanish league title 11 times.**
 
 
• They play their home games at the** Wanda Metropolitano stadium**, which has a capacity of over 68,000 spectators.
